Resolve the layer tension for branch coverage. _extract_branches is in components/; L1 must be in services/. Specify passing extracted_branches in the capture payload, or moving coverage to offline meta/ replay.
Add one paste-ready eval_capture + publish_plan snippet mirroring task_understanding at react_loop.py:898-946.
Fix Phase 0 phase order to use real WorkflowPhase enum names; keep re-attribution of COMPLETION/EVALUATION sink.
Clarify plan_changed gating — score L1 only on changed plans; tag re-emissions.
Restore concrete paths: services/governance/plan_probe.py, tests/fixtures/plan/plan_benchmark_v1.json, sibling exemplar test_task_understanding_gate_benchmark.py.
Note BlackBox STEP_PLANNED vs eval.plan — complementary, not redundant.
Tighten length — executive "start here" block up front; full phases as appendix.

Standout answer — best empirical rigor in the benchmark. Ran the transition failure matrix on 72 workflows, surfaced the completion sink trap with real counts, correctly refused to instrument tool_execution → completion (32), and spelled out the re-attribution join across eval_capture, goaljudge cache, and black_box. Anti-gut framing and Tier-A downstream spine are canon-correct.

Improve:

Say explicitly: "meta/analysis.py exists; build_transition_failure_matrix() is not built yet" — matches handbook and fixes the grader gap.
Complete one re-attribution pass — even 10 hand-joined workflows + a partial post-join table, so the team gets a named seam candidate (or "goal_judge vs synthesis_validator — too close to call").
Add phase→seam mapping — re-attributed EVALUATION → goal_judge, OUTPUT_VALIDATION → synthesis_validator, ROUTING → plan/select_planning_depth, etc.
Restore blast-radius tie-break when two cells are close (false downgrade > cosmetic).
